headline.en: UNI trades 34% below the DAO's own $5.96 burn anchor while still net inflationary — bearish until v4 fees or real-yield activate.
headline.zh: UNI 现价较 DAO 自设的 $5.96 回购锚定价低 34%，供应仍处净通胀；v4 手续费或 real-yield 提案落地前，维持看空。

keyChanges.en: Price at $3.94 sits 34% below the DAO's implied $5.96 burn anchor and is pressing back into the $3-3.5 retail capitulation zone; the $4-7 institutional band has failed as support.
keyChanges.zh: 现价 $3.94 较 DAO 隐含的 $5.96 回购锚定价低 34%，正重新逼近 $3-3.5 的散户割肉区；$4-7 机构建仓带已失守。

keyChanges.en: Annualized buyback of $14.34M retires just 3.64M UNI against 20M UNI of fixed emission — burn offsets only 18% of supply growth, net inflation stays at +1.64%/yr.
keyChanges.zh: 年化回购 $14.34M 仅销毁 3.64M UNI，对应 2000 万 UNI 的固定排放，销毁量只抵消 18% 的供应增量，净通胀维持 +1.64%/年。

keyChanges.en: Binance long/short account ratio at 2.31 with funding barely positive (+0.01%) — retail is crowded long without leverage conviction, a textbook squeeze-lower setup.
keyChanges.zh: Binance 多空账户比 2.31，而 funding rate 仅 +0.01%，散户单边做多但杠杆并未跟进，是典型的向下挤压结构。

contrarianObservation.en: Two live governance items — 'Activate v4 Protocol Fees' and 'Protocol Fee Expansion: Robinhood Chain' temp checks — could step-change the revenue base before the real-yield RFC even surfaces. The smart long here isn't front-running burn-to-yield; it's front-running a re-pricing of the burn base itself, which can happen inside 1-4 weeks with far less headline risk.
contrarianObservation.zh: 论坛上两项 Temp Check——『Activate v4 Protocol Fees』与『Robinhood Chain 手续费扩展』——若通过，可在 real-yield 提案尚未登场前直接抬升协议收入基数。聪明的多头抢跑的其实不是 burn 转 yield 的叙事切换，而是回购基数本身的重定价；这一变化可能在 1-4 周内发生，且头条风险远小于 real-yield 表决。

watchNext.en: Temp Check outcome on 'Activate v4 Protocol Fees' — passage would materially expand the buyback base and could flip net inflation to net deflation without any RFC on yield.
watchNext.zh: 『Activate v4 Protocol Fees』Temp Check 表决结果——若通过将实质性扩大回购收入基数，无需 real-yield 提案即可能把净通胀翻转为净通缩。

watchNext.en: Any formal surfacing of the real-yield RFC on gov.uniswap.org — the single largest re-rating catalyst; its absence is why UNI can't hold the $5.96 anchor.
watchNext.zh: gov.uniswap.org 上 real-yield RFC 是否正式发起——UNI 单一最大的估值重定价催化剂，其缺席正是价格无法守住 $5.96 锚定的核心原因。

watchNext.en: UNI/ETH ratio at 0.0021 — a clean break below 0.0020 confirms continued relative capitulation vs the L1 host and invalidates any 'DEX beta to ETH' thesis.
watchNext.zh: UNI/ETH 比率现为 0.0021，若有效跌破 0.0020 则确认相对 ETH 的持续走弱，『DEX 相对 ETH 的 beta』叙事也随之失效。

fullReasoning.en: UNI is bearish on structure, not sentiment. Price at $3.94 has broken back below the $5.96 the DAO itself paid to retire 100M tokens — the treasury's own fair-value mark is now underwater by 34%, and the $4-7 institutional accumulation band has failed as support. The math is the real problem: annualized revenue of $84.37M funds a $14.34M buyback that retires only 3.64M UNI against 20M UNI of fixed emission, so net supply still grows +1.64% a year. The burn narrative does not survive contact with a spreadsheet at this price. Governance is quiet where it matters — no active proposals, and the real-yield pivot that would re-rate UNI as a cash-flow asset has not even reached RFC stage. Positioning compounds the setup: long/short at 2.31 with funding at +0.01% signals crowded retail longs without leveraged conviction, and $5.24M of 24h volume against a $2.46B cap means any real seller moves price. Unichain TVL at $27.41M is a rounding error that undercuts the multi-chain revenue thesis. What limits the downside is proximity to $3-3.5 historical support and two live temp checks (v4 fees, Robinhood Chain) that could reset the revenue base within weeks. Bearish 1-4 weeks — but keep stops tight, governance can flip this quickly.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 的看空是结构性的，而非情绪性的。现价 $3.94 已跌破 DAO 自身以 $5.96 回购 100M 代币的隐含成本——国库自己标注的公允价值已倒挂 34%，$4-7 机构建仓带亦已失守。真正的问题出在数字：年化协议收入 $84.37M 仅能支撑 $14.34M 回购、销毁 3.64M UNI，对应 2000 万 UNI 的固定排放，净供应仍以 +1.64%/年扩张，「burn 叙事」在此价位一算就崩。治理端在关键议题上失声——无进行中提案，能把 UNI 重估为现金流资产的 real-yield 提案连 RFC 阶段都未进入。仓位结构进一步放大风险：多空比 2.31、funding rate 仅 +0.01%，散户单边做多但杠杆未跟；$2.46B 市值对应 $5.24M 的 24h 成交量极度稀薄，任何真实卖压都会显著推低价格。Unichain TVL 仅 $27.41M，多链收入叙事基本证伪。下行空间的限制来自两点：$3-3.5 的历史支撑近在咫尺；论坛上 v4 协议手续费与 Robinhood Chain 两项 Temp Check 若通过，可能在数周内直接抬升收入基数。1-4 周维持看空，但止损应收紧——治理变量可能迅速反转格局。
